description: Find market niches either by describing them in words or by conditions on the niche itself: size, level in the hierarchy, median quality index, share of growing members (members whose visits grew by more than 10% over the last month), leading country. Every project underneath these niches is a site where revenue has been observed, so a niche here is a market rather than a topic. Returns niche ids with a gloss, the number of member projects and a quality summary — never their member sites. With text, the results are the niches closest in meaning; sorting by size, index or growth then orders the closest ones only, as many as relevance_pool_cohorts in capabilities. Costs the base price plus the first-seen price for every niche shown to your organization for the first time this period, and each such niche spends one unit of coverage; call with estimate: true to see the price and get a quote_token first. This is the cheapest way into a market: use it before searching for projects when the user cannot yet name a single site in the space.

cursor.description: Continue a previous page: repeat the same query parameters (limit may change) and pass the cursor it returned

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

growing_share_min.description: Minimum share of members whose visits grew by more than 10% over the last month, percent

index_min.description: Minimum median quality index of members, 0..100

level.description: Level in the niche hierarchy: 1 holds the narrowest niches, each higher level groups the level below; see capabilities for the levels

max_size.description: Maximum number of member projects in the corpus

min_size.description: Minimum number of member projects in the corpus

limit.description: Rows to return; defaults to list_max in capabilities and is refused above it

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

sort.description: relevance (closeness to text; the default with text, and it requires text), size (the default without text), index (median quality index) or growth (share of growing members); with text, size, index and growth order the relevance_pool_cohorts closest niches. Index and growth are shares of members, so without filters.min_size niches of a few members come first

text.description: Free-text description of the market to look for

name: search_cohorts
title: Search niches
